source.text: novus his super anxia turbat corda metus: sparsis subito correpta canistris silvestris regina chori decurrit in aequum vertice ab Ogygio trifidamque huc tristis et illuc lumine sanguineo pinum disiectat et ardens erectam attonitis implet clamoribus urbem:
source.text_original: novus his super anxia turbat / corda metus: sparsis subito correpta canistris / silvestris regina chori decurrit in aequum / vertice ab Ogygio trifidamque huc tristis et illuc / lumine sanguineo pinum disiectat et ardens / erectam attonitis implet clamoribus urbem: /
source.text_english: A new fear above all this troubles their anxious hearts: suddenly seized with baskets scattered about, the queen of the woodland band runs down from the Ogygian summit to the plain, and, sad, with blood-red eyes, hurls the three-pronged pine hither and thither and, blazing, fills the startled city with her cries, as she stands upright.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_original: Tartareo turn sacra Iovi Stygiisque ferebat / manibus Alcimede tanto super auxia nato, / siquid ab excitis melius praenosceret umbris.
reuse.text_english: Then Alcimede was bringing sacred rites to Tartarean Jove and to the Stygian spirits, as an added support for her mighty son, if from the summoned shades she might learn anything better in advance.
